City approves plan to plant 50,000 trees by 2030

The program aims to cool the hottest neighborhoods and will cost about 40 million dollars over five years.

By Elena Ruiz, City Reporter
September 29, 2026, 6:05 PM

The city council voted eleven to two on Tuesday to approve the largest tree-planting program in its history.

Officials said the first trees will go into the ground next spring, starting in districts with the least shade.
